name: validated-world
description: Keep project design and documentation consistent beyond an agent context window.

interface.longDescription: ValidatedWorld helps AI agents maintain a graph of project knowledge and reason consistently across projects larger than their context window. It tracks decisions and dependencies, retrieves targeted context, and can fan out reviews to batches of fresh, zero-context sub-agents so proposed changes receive focused, independent scrutiny before they propagate through the project. The objective is graph-wide conceptual consistency: not an absolute guarantee, but a systematic attempt to detect and resolve inconsistencies throughout the connected knowledge base, managed by your AI agent. The graph is stored in your project as a human-friendly HTML file that you can open in a browser to read and explore.
defaultPrompt: Create a ValidatedWorld design document for this project.
Find the decisions and dependencies relevant to my proposed change.
Update this design decision and review its consequences before saving.
